description: GRC InSpectre: Legacy Meltdown/Spectre mitigation and performance diagnostic for older Windows systems.
notes: GRC does not publish a static SHA-256 checksum for this download. The manifest omits hash rather than inventing a value.

Obsolete for evaluating current Windows security posture. Do not use it as a substitute for current Windows updates, firmware updates, or modern security diagnostics; its UI can alter mitigation settings.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Unable to read the published Last Updated date for InSpectre.' }
